Raspberry White Peach Smoothie
By: Kate
Published: Thursday, June 17, 2010 - 11:11am

Ingredients




1/4 Greek yogurt (in my opinion, FAGE brand is best)
1/2 cup fresh raspberries
3 tablespoons milk
2 white peaches, depending on size (peeled and roughly sliced; reserving one segment for garnish)
5 large ice cubes
2 tablespoons sugar

Preparation

1 Blend together the yogurt, raspberries and milk to desired consistency. Add the white peach pieces and ice cubes and mix. Add sugar to taste as desired.

About


Find more about this recipe, here: http://maitredemoda.wordpress.com/2010/06/16/raspberry-white-peach-smoothie/
